findings.summary: Review request and all control schemas remain byte-bound to the frozen commit, capability prohibitions remain enforced by reviewed code and prior negative review history is append-only.
Temporal union comparison, exact frozen Git identity, semantic locks, referential closure, safe paths, artifact counters and acceptance binding remain fail-closed.

A legitimate READY descendant is not restricted to metadata-only changed paths. Content outside review_scope can change after freeze, including unreviewed capability or governance text, without invalidating canonical READY.
An instant with equal finite bounds and exclusive inclusivity can collapse to an empty temporal possible set without rejection.
A spatial correction can move to a different valid-time world state inside the same atomic target series because valid-time invariance is enforced only for spatial refine.
Progressive refinement contract lifecycle headers can contradict package and review-registry READY state.
Review identifiers are not required to be unique across prior and current registry entries.
Finding identifiers are not required to be unique within one review artifact.
